description: Committed, hash-only counterpart of privacy.local.json (design ΔH): the guard can run in CI and in the lint against the style guide without the protected strings entering git. Each entry is the SHA-256 of the normalised term and its token count, so the scan can hash every n-gram of that width. Generate an entry with: node -e "import('./dist/privacy.js').then(m=>{const n=m.normaliseTerm('the-term');console.log(JSON.stringify({tokens:m.tokenise(n).length,sha256:m.termHash(n)}))})" from tools/council.
